output_list.reason: This integer overflow vulnerability occurs when the balance of the contract is used as the argument for a function call, leading to potential unhandled exceptions within the call-chain.
This vulnerability arises when an operation results in integer overflow, causing truncated values due to limitations in the EVM stack.
This vulnerability exists when the argument of a function call is an integer variable, which can be exploited for malicious behaviors due to potential unhandled exceptions within the call-chain.
The timestamp dependency vulnerability exists when a function uses the block timestamp as a condition to conduct critical operations, such as transferring Ether.
The block number dependency vulnerability exists when a function uses the block number (block.number) as a condition in a branch statement, which can be exploited for malicious behaviors.
